purpose: Independent literature validation of least-squares pressure recovery from the streamfunction-vorticity solver

benchmark.primary_reference: Botella and Peyret, Computers & Fluids 27 (1998) 421-433, doi:10.1016/S0045-7930(98)00002-4
benchmark.tabulated_cross_check: Tran et al., Computers, Materials & Continua 70 (2022) 4905-4921, doi:10.32604/cmc.2022.020889
benchmark.lid_direction_mapping: Botella-Peyret horizontal pressure is reflected about x/L=0.5 to match the positive-lid convention used by the course solver

interpretation: The refined centerlines agree with the literature benchmark while the global derivative diagnostic remains corner dominated; both facts are reported.
